comments: Statable WCAG Checker is a free, open-to-all browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox). It runs entirely in the browser: no network requests of its own, no telemetry, nothing stored. Documentation: https://statable.com/docs/wcag-checker/ Privacy policy: https://statable.com/legal/wcag-checker-privacy
features: Free browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox that runs axe-core on the page you are viewing and lists WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A and AA issues in a side panel, each with the rule behind it and a link to the fix. Highlights affected elements on the page. Works on password-protected pages, makes no network requests and stores nothing.
title: Statable WCAG Checker
